content.title: Oscars 2026: Full Winners List Updating Live
content.text: The 2026 Oscar Winners Ryan Coogler wins Best Original Screenplay for Sinners. Photo: Stewart Cook/Disney via Getty Images The Actor, Critics Choice, and BAFTA Awards are all done and, finally, it’s time for the main event: the 98th Academy Awards. This year, the primary contenders heading into the ceremony are Sinners and One Battle After Another, which ended up with 16 and 13 nominations, respectively. Sinners ended up winning four categories, including Best Original Screenplay and Best Actor (yay Michael B. Jordan!) and OBAA had a solid night with six wins, including Paul Thomas Anderson’s first Oscar. Elsewhere, international movies like Norway’s Sentimental Value nabbed a win, and there was even a tie! Host Conan O’Brien guided us through a night full of inside jokes (watch the movies that are nominated people!) and engaging acceptance speeches. Below, find the full list of Oscar winners.
